info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT Alerting Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Creates a rule for every check and a rule for one check, reads and lists them (oldest first), updates the definition, pauses and resumes a rule, reads the audit ledger in order, lists alerts (none: the tenant has no checks) and runs an evaluation that has nothing to open. A second folder proves the service is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-ALR-00403 on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long name, missing or unknown impact and urgency, missing requester, malformed check id, missing tenant), duplicate names (409) on create and on rename, illegal transitions, updating a paused rule, tenant isolation, unknown alerts, an unknown status filter, no way to write an alert by hand and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (alrOrganisationId). Opening an alert and its real incident, the recovery note, the race of simultaneous evaluations, the paused rule and the oldest-rule-wins choice are proved by the platform smoke (alerting-smoke).
info.name: IT Alerting Service - Alert Rule Suite
